description: Run a forecast now. Reserves AI credits up front, dispatches the backtest + projection + correlation pipeline, and returns either the completed result inline (wait_seconds > 0 and the run finishes in time) or a run_id you can poll with get_forecast_run.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish before returning a poll handle. 0 = return immediately with the run_id.

name: run_forecast

poll_tool.description: Tool to poll if the run is still running ("get_forecast_run").

status.description: pending while queued, running mid-execution, completed/failed/refunded when terminal.
